Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat) and Tropical Storm CRISING
Issued at: 2:00 PM, 18 July 2025(Friday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Metro Manila, Bulacan, Cavite, Bataan, Zambales and Pampanga.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Quezon, Laguna, Batangas, Tarlac, Nueva Ecija and Rizal which may persist within 3 hours.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 5:00 PM today.

For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.

data.raw_text:
Sa panayam sa kanya ni Christian Esguerra sa programang “Facts First,” sinabi ni Bicol Saro Rep. Terry Ridon na tila sumulpot umano na parang kabute ang Dolomite beach project.

Aniya, isa umano siya sa mga nag-raise ng red flag sa naturang proyekto na noon ay sinasabing para sa “mental health” ng mga Pilipino.

Nabuking din umano noong 2020 na hindi kasama ang Dolomite project sa Manila Bay rehabilitation master plan ng National Economic and Development Authority (NEDA).

Idinagdag pa ni Ridon na gumastos ang bansa ng P389 na milyon para sa naturang proyekto upang tugunan ang coastal flooding, erosion, at iba pa ngunit kamakailan lamang ay sinabi ng Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) na ang sanhi ng pagbaha sa Maynila ay ang Dolomite project.
